decisions.reason: Uses symptom-log and contrast-probe: tab claimed/titled correctly, meta.status stays 'none' while file-trace's own RPC reads the same file; localizes the fault to the api-workspace-files Remote→host resource-provider/metadata chain, explicitly rules out disk existence and the renderer, and notes the declared host row does not prove activation. Does not demand an unseen internal function.

Correctly treats the 62/62 per-module sweep as authoritative and explicitly rejects the joined 4–5 KB 404 as a non-loader access pattern rather than missing modules. However it never mentions the loader's bounded URL limit driving partitioning (attributes the 404 only to malformed/unsupported joins) and does not address the manifest's 60-entries vs probe's 62 discrepancy at all.

Separates the dsh-paste-input fold warnings as an independent benign warning family unrelated to the resource read, and uses the boot manifest to explain the textpreview→documentpreview rename and the session-only canOpen scope, correctly tying that scope to the outside/absolute-address claim failure while stating it does not explain the session tab's stalled metadata.

Orders: clean host restart once → rollback to the #5999-verified 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch → upstream follow-up appended to discussion #5999; explicitly rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback as masking the host defect; contrasts the alpha.2 round (62/62 200, static serving fine) with the alpha.1 roster mismatch to treat it as prior art, not proof alpha.2 lacks bytes. Only proposed actions, no execution.

Lists a complete forensic pack (versions/history, OS, junction-linked plugins, full boot manifest and HTML census, probe results with the invalid-join caveat, contrast probe with meta.status, console excerpt, workspace-root inputs) and proposes named host diagnostics: boot-time cross-plane service/Remote consistency assertion and a Remote liveness handshake, which are meaningful failing-chain readiness checks.

caps.reason: The report affirmatively concludes the opposite: the joined-URL 404 is an invalid hand-crafted access pattern that must never be cited as missing modules, while the per-module sweep proves all artifacts serve.
The report explicitly rejects plugin-side rewrite/retry/fallback as a cure, arguing it would mask the host defect and duplicate the capability; only host restart/rollback/upstream are recommended.
